attributes.residual:
NONE - real 14 -> 0, byte-exact. MECHANISM: 13 differing words confined to [0x1c,0x6c), where the target interleaves its SDA-relative float loads among the incoming-argument register copies in a different order than our stream. The rule is a permutation over [0x1c,0x6c) with order [0,3,2,1,5,7,6,9,8,10,12,11,14,13,15,16,17,18,4,19] - mostly adjacent lfs-against-copy transpositions, plus ONE long displacement where source atom 4 (our `addi r30,r18,lbl_8023CA40@l` at +0x2c) travels to destination slot 18 at +0x64 carrying its ADDR16_LO relocation - plus ONE copy-form site at +0x4c (our `addi r23,r6,0` against the target's `mr r23,r6`; destination AND source register already agree, so it is a pure encoding change and never a disguised recolor, and the `unconditional` proof mode applies because both sides are copies rD<-rS with rS != 0). NO register stage at all: permutation plus that one form site reproduce the target bytes exactly, so the rule carries neither copy_register_fields nor register_fields - a fifth instance of CN's finding that the form stage is often the whole remainder.

WHY IT WAS OPEN UNTIL NOW, and this is the transferable part. claim.CN_census-rerun-canary-validated-filter.20260901.v1 left this function open as one of three with '9-20 atom windows, beyond an exhaustive 8-atom search, the obvious next target for a smarter derivation than brute force'. TWO independent blockers had to fall, and either alone would still have hidden it. (1) ENUMERATION IS THE WRONG ALGORITHM. HV census step 4 never asked for a search; it asks that the order be DERIVED by matching atoms on register-erased form AND relocation identity. Done as a sparse bipartite matching over slot compatibility, the answer here is UNIQUE - exactly ONE slot-compatible candidate order exists over a 20-atom window whose enumeration would be 20! - so window size stops being the binding constraint entirely. (2) THE BINDING KEY WAS WRONG. Our objects record SDA21 relocations at instruction+2 and the extracted targets at instruction+0 (measured image-wide: 14259 of 14259 versus 14265 of 14265), so a filter comparing raw r_offset rejects every order over a window holding one. This window holds eight. Keying binding by the owning instruction fixes it in one line and leaves all four canaries byte-identical.
